Title: Login page renders
Assertions:
[DOM] 'Username' and 'Password' inputs visible
[DOM] 'Login' button visible and enabled
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] No uncaught errors
[NETWORK] No 4xx/5xx on same-origin requests

Title: Standard user signs in
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{STANDARD_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
[WAIT] Wait for the Products page
Assertions:
[URL] Ends with /inventory.html
[DOM] Products title visible
[DOM] At least one product card visible
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] No uncaught errors
[NETWORK] No 4xx/5xx on same-origin requests
Failure_Signals: Error banner; stays on login page

Title: Add one product to cart
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{STANDARD_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
[WAIT] Wait for the Products page
[ACT] Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Assertions:
[DOM] Button on 'Sauce Labs Backpack' reads 'Remove'
[DOM] Cart badge shows 1

Title: Complete a checkout
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{STANDARD_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
[WAIT] Wait for the Products page
[ACT] Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
[ACT] Click the cart icon
[ACT] Click 'Checkout'
[ACT] Fill 'First Name' with {{CHECKOUT_FIRST_NAME}}
[ACT] Fill 'Last Name' with {{CHECKOUT_LAST_NAME}}
[ACT] Fill 'Zip/Postal Code' with {{CHECKOUT_POSTAL_CODE}}
[ACT] Click 'Continue'
[ASSERT] Read Item total, Tax and Total on the overview
[ACT] Click 'Finish'
Assertions:
[TEXT] Item total = $29.99; Tax = $2.40; Total = $32.39
[URL] Ends with /checkout-complete.html
[TEXT] 'Thank you for your order!' visible
[DOM] Cart badge not shown
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] No uncaught errors
[NETWORK] No 4xx/5xx on same-origin requests
Failure_Signals: Totals do not add up; Finish does nothing

Title: Logout ends the session
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{STANDARD_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
[WAIT] Wait for the Products page
[ACT] Open the burger menu
[ACT] Click 'Logout'
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/inventory.html
Assertions:
[URL] Lands on the login page
[TEXT] Error mentions '/inventory.html' and being logged in
